identity.canonicalName: Zara Home Medium Wooden Jewelry Box, Brown

classification.verdictNote: Zara Home's own in-house design, sold under its reference number. No individual designer credited.
classification.summary: A Zara Home original: a rubberwood box with a glass lid over linen-lined compartments for rings, earrings and watches, plus drawers underneath. Zara Home designs in-house and doesn't credit designers. The same reference is also sold on zara.com.

specs.label: Storage
specs.value: Compartments for jewelry, rings and watches under a glass lid; drawer storage below

quality: Rubberwood is a plantation hardwood: solid and stable, a step below oak or walnut, and usually stained to look darker. The glass lid lets you see everything without opening it.

Small drawer detail to check: the US page says one drawer, while zara.com describes two. Same reference number, so it's likely one physical drawer front split inside, but look at the photos before buying.

maker.name: Zara Home
paragraphs: Zara Home is the homewares chain of Inditex, the Spanish group behind Zara, founded in 2003. It designs its products in-house and sells them through its own stores and site, with no outside dealers.
Its jewelry boxes come in wood, lacquer, metal and mirror finishes; this one sits in the mid-size wooden line next to a smaller watch box ($79.90).

worth.line: Fair at $129 if you like the glass lid; check the drawer count before buying.

price.note: Middle of the range for a wooden glass-top box this size. Other stores not yet checked by photo.

design.note: Clean Zara Home design, no designer behind it.

materials.note: Rubberwood with glass and linen: solid, but not a premium wood.
